summary: Two Raleigh retail refinance opportunities met all evidence requirements as of the 2026-08-31 cutoff: Elm Square 1 (matures 2027-01-15; $8.64M original principal) and Elm Point 3 (matures 2027-03-15; $9.936M original principal). All others were excluded due to post-cutoff publication, non-Retail/market scope, unconfirmed or amended/extended maturities, released/unknown loan status, stale ownership, non-owner records, or invalid contact role/employment. Duplicate records for Elm Square 1 were consolidated.
limitations: Outstanding balances are not provided in sources (null).
Potential post-cutoff changes (e.g., releases or amendments published after 2026-08-31) are not considered.
Some exclusions rely on asset-type changes from executed amendments; if later re-amended after cutoff, such changes are not captured here.
Deduplication is based on matching entity_id and corroborative base sources; if additional undisclosed duplicates exist, they are not reflected.
Email availability is source-dependent; one shortlisted contact lacks alternate contact channels beyond what is published.
